cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find the right form for your poem. The magazine sent it back because it needs a booklet of its own.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Or because it's hopeless. If you think that too, I'll stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep writing. I'll help make the booklet, and you can choose every page. They couldn't give this voice enough room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put that on the cover and sign your name underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. 'A voice that deserves more room.' You choose the type; I'll put my name where you want it. We'll send them a copy so they can see what their little magazine couldn't hold.

reason: Make A confident editorial management yield page/type/signature control to keep B writing, accepting B public accountability condition while sustaining the protective false explanation.
